summary: Iteration 8 — Tasks page (Sales-hub-CRM replica) + multi-currency support verified end-to-end. Backend: 15 NEW pytest cases pass in test_tasks_currency.py (public settings no-auth, currency PATCH persistence + reset, /api/users paginated lookup with auth gate, /api/tasks full CRUD with denormalized label enrichment for company_name/lead_name/deal_name/pic_name/assigned_to_name, search+lead_id filters, /google-calendar/sync-task 400 when keys absent + 200 with calendar_synced=true persisted when keys present). Combined with prior 141 tests → 156/156 pytest pass (100%). Frontend: After fixing 3 compile/runtime BLOCKERS introduced this iteration (see updated_files), /admin/tasks renders correctly with search-tasks-input, create-task-btn, deals-filter, sidebar Tasks entry; Add Task slide-in panel opens with company/deal/sales-person/payment selectors; Customer-facing Landing shows currency-switcher in navbar — selecting USD flips ALL prices from 'RM …' to '$ …' (verified: 5 RM→0 RM, 6 $ occurrences after switch), localStorage 'tp_currency' persists across reload; /admin/settings shows currency-settings card with default-currency-select + add-currency-btn.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec calls for a 'Status' select in the Add Task panel ('select Company auto-fills PIC, optional Deal, Status, Payment status; submit creates task'). Current panel only exposes: Company, Deal, PIC, Sales Person, Payment. Task title is also implicit (no task-title-input testid). Backend accepts 'status' field — UI just doesn't surface it on create.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> nested inside <option> (caused by dev-tool instrumentation x-source-* wrappers around static-imported `currencies` mapping at Settings.jsx:533). Not user-visible but pollutes console. Consider hard-coding option text without the dynamic <span> wrapper or marking the option content non-instrumentable.

action_items: (MEDIUM) Tasks Add Task panel: add a Status <select> (pending/in_progress/completed) and ideally a free-form Title input — current panel cannot capture either, so created tasks default to status='pending' and a server-derived title.

(LOW) Settings.jsx:533 currency-row <option>{c.code} – {c.name}</option> — the dev instrumentation wraps the {c.code} in a <span>, triggering React hydration warnings. Ensure the option's children are plain text (e.g., template literal) or disable instrumentation for that node.
critical_code_review_comments: BLOCKER FIXED — currency.jsx imported api as default (`import api from './api'`) but lib/api.js only exports named { API, api }. Fixed to `import { api } from './api';`. Without this fix the entire app failed to compile.
BLOCKER FIXED — PAQuote.jsx had 4 orphan lines (723-726) leftover from a botched edit (`-green-700" : ""}`}>{value} ... }`) causing a SyntaxError. Removed.

BLOCKER FIXED — App.js used <Tasks /> on /admin/tasks route but never imported the Tasks component. Added `import Tasks from '@/admin/Tasks';`. Without this, /admin/tasks threw ReferenceError: Tasks is not defined and the AdminLayout tree crashed at runtime.
Tasks.jsx is reportedly ~849 lines (per E1's spec) — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting list/table/panel/edit-modal into separate files.

sales_crm.py /tasks: GET response shape changed from List → paginated dict {items,total,page,limit,total_pages} — broke the legacy regression test test_sales_crm.py::TestTasks::test_list_tasks_by_lead which was reading r.json() as a list. I patched the regression test to handle both shapes (test fix only, no business-logic change).
admin.py /settings/public is correctly unauthenticated and returns only safe fields (default_currency + supported_currencies). Good separation from /admin/settings.

Multi-currency rate semantics: currency.jsx convert() = active.rate / defaultMeta.rate. Since base is MYR(rate=1.0) and USD rate=0.21, 100 MYR → 100 * 0.21 = 21.00 USD. Make sure admin understands rates are 'units of target per 1 unit of base' (not the inverse). Worth a tooltip in the Settings UI.

rca of the issue: Three blocker bugs introduced in iteration 8 by E1 — all fixed. RCA: (1) currency.jsx used default import for ./api which only has named exports (api, API). Fix: switch to named import. (2) PAQuote.jsx had orphan lines 723-726 left from a search-replace that didn't fully overwrite — Babel parser failed at the bare `-green-700"` token. Fix: delete the dead lines. (3) App.js wired <Tasks /> into /admin/tasks route but the import statement for Tasks was never added — runtime ReferenceError after login. Fix: add `import Tasks from '@/admin/Tasks';`. After these three one-line fixes the app compiles cleanly and all listed user flows pass.
